thesis: The thirty-for-thirty protocol combines a small daily block with visible tracking and commitment.
summary: The selected passages describe thirty minutes of focused effort each day for a month. The creator says the bounded duration reduces starting resistance and encourages choosing something worth sustained attention. Scheduling at a consistent time and visibly marking execution are practical supports. Claims that this makes failure impossible or transforms any skill overstate what the source demonstrates; this note records the routine without those guarantees.
